[[]red]⚠️ Stable Build is Outdated ⚠️[[]]
The current stable release doesn't support Mindustry v8. All new features and v8 compatibility are actively being built in [[]accent]Indev[[]] (In-Development) snapshots.

[[]accent]How to play the v8 Indevs:[[]]
The default install button ignores pre-releases. To get the latest content:
[[]gray]1.[[]] Tap [[]accent]View Releases[[]] in this menu.
[[]gray]2.[[]] Select the newest [[]orange]indev[[]] version.
[[]gray]3.[[]] Install it manually.
